name: Corner jump: standing on the platform's end with the body over a flush spike pit, then a standing jump
techNote: A platform (top y 0) ends at x 0 at a pit filled to its top with spikes (layer 6, spikeScript; x 0-300, flush with the platform, a floor under them), and a landing platform starts at x 582. Standing, the hurtbox's bottom (y-27) is 7 u above the platform, so a floor-level spike under it doesn't touch it, and the ground check needs only the back ray (x-15 facing right) on the platform: the dot can stand anywhere up to x 15, its hurtbox reaching 40 u over the spikes. The dot walks in from rest (stick right for 14 inputs; the stick at rest stops it at once) and stands at x 7.8, 33 u of it over the spikes, for 20 ticks, then jumps with the stick full right: the standing jump from there lands on the far platform. Stopping a tick short (x -1.4) the same jump falls short (the platform's edge sits between their reaches, x 579-585 for the corner, 576 at most a tick back), and a tick further (x 17.0) the back ray leaves the platform: the dot starts to fall, the hurtbox sinks into the spikes and dies on the 2nd Stay. Ghosts: short, further.

ghosts.label: Corner jump: stand 33 u over the spikes, standing jump
Stop a tick short: the jump falls short
Stop a tick further: the back ray leaves the platform, falls in
